responsibility: Provides rustc’s AST-to-source pretty-printing layer by exposing public entry points that create printer state and route crates, AST nodes, tokens, and token streams through a shared `State`-based formatting engine. Within that engine, it manages annotations and comments, shared syntax printing helpers, sequence traversal for delimited lists, expression rendering with precedence and reparsing-preserving parenthesization fixups, and item-level formatting for crate and module contents; together these pieces produce macro-facing and general Rust source output, with regression tests validating representative pretty-printing behavior.
